label: V6.4.25 - FSAGS 54/94 DIRECT FIELD EDITOR
notes: Fixes F/SAGS-CXR/54 and /94 direct touch entry so a field editor always opens on tap. The runtime still prefers the native core editor when available, then falls back to a dedicated 54/94 editor. Checkbox interaction remains direct and signature fields are untouched.
message: V6.4.25: sửa dứt điểm chạm trực tiếp mẫu 54/94 nhưng không hiện bảng nhập liệu.
